title: 新河峽大橋
summary: 新河峽大橋位於美國西維吉尼亞州，主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺），橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺），1977 年通車，以免塗裝的 COR-TEN 耐候鋼建造。本課從兩鉸桁架拱與峽谷地形出發，分析排架立柱、上承式桁架、焊接箱形弦桿與低溫韌性，再拆解跨越峽谷的纜索吊運、以油井套管作背拉索的懸臂架設與 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂完成的合龍，最後談線形量測、載重評等、耐候鋼維護與橋梁日活動的管理。
summaryEn: New River Gorge Bridge in West Virginia has a 1,700 ft (about 518 m) arch, a total length of 3,030 ft (about 924 m) and a deck about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River; it opened in 1977, built of unpainted COR-TEN weathering steel. Starting from the two-hinged truss arch and the gorge, the course examines spandrel bents, deck trusses, welded box chords and low-temperature toughness, then the cableway across the gorge, cantilever erection held by oil-well-casing tiebacks and the 1976 closure with 16 hydraulic jacks, ending with geometry surveys, load rating, care of weathering steel and managing Bridge Day.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 合龍千斤頂練習：假設合龍前每個半拱重 W = 4,000 t（約 39.2 MN），重心距拱腳鉸 110 m，背拉索對鉸的力臂 60 m，所需背拉力 T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN。每側 8 具 1,250 短噸千斤頂，能力約 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN，利用率約 81%。下放時放出背拉索 Δc = 0.15 m，半拱轉角 θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad；拱頂端點距鉸高約 112.8 m、水平約 259 m，端點向中央移動約 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m，下降約 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m。半拱弧長約 292 m，溫度變化 10 °C 使長度變化約 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm，所以最後幾公分的對位必須在溫度穩定時完成。數值為教學假設，不代表新河峽大橋的實際設計或施工數據。
workedExample.textEn: Closure-jack exercise: assume each half-arch weighs W = 4,000 t (about 39.2 MN) before closure, with its centroid 110 m from the arch-foot hinge and a 60 m tieback lever arm about the hinge, so the required tieback force is T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN. Eight 1,250 short-ton jacks per side give about 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN, a utilisation of about 81%. Paying out Δc = 0.15 m of tieback rotates the half-arch by θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad; with the tip about 112.8 m above and about 259 m horizontally from the hinge, it moves about 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m toward mid-span and drops about 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m. A half-arch about 292 m long changes length by about 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm for 10 °C, so the last few centimetres of alignment must be made when temperature is stable. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design or erection data of the bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」與「排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch" and "Bents, deck trusses and bearings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩鉸桁架拱推力」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。主拱是兩鉸桁架拱，只在兩端支點設鉸、拱頂不設鉸，拱矢 370 英尺，矢跨比約 1:4.6；拱肋桁架深度由拱頂約 34 英尺增加到支點處約 53 英尺。國家史蹟登錄文件指出，上下弦桿在錨碇處透過位於兩弦之間的銷共同承受壓力。橋面荷載經排架立柱傳到拱上，再以軸壓與推力送入兩岸的混凝土推力座。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩鉸桁架拱推力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel. The main arch is a two-hinged truss arch, hinged only at its supports and not at the crown, with a rise of 370 ft and a rise-to-span ratio of about 1:4.6; rib depth grows from about 34 ft at the crown to about 53 ft at the supports. The National Register nomination notes that top and bottom chords share compression at the anchorage through a pin placed midway between them. Deck loads pass down spandrel bents to the arch and then, as axial force and thrust, into concrete thrust blocks on each side. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m、f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m，取總荷載 w = 250 kN/m：H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN。若拱矢降為 L/6 ≈ 86.4 m，推力升到約 97,100 kN，增加約 31%。w 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). With L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m, f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m and a total load w = 250 kN/m, H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN. Reducing the rise to L/6 ≈ 86.4 m raises the thrust to about 97,100 kN, about 31% more. w is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). With L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m, f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m and a total load w = 250 kN/m, H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN. Reducing the rise to L/6 ≈ 86.4 m raises the thrust to about 97,100 kN, about 31% more. w is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch", which statement holds?

拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。

Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid.
Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f).

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩鉸桁架拱推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拱橋選址時應先完成岩盤調查與推力座的穩定分析，並把推力座背後的排水列為長期維護項目；監測計畫須包含拱腳的三維位移量測與異常門檻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Siting an arch requires rock investigation and thrust-block stability analysis first, with drainage behind the blocks treated as a long-term maintenance item; the monitoring plan must include 3D movement of the arch feet with alert thresholds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。

knowledge.text: 拱橋選址時應先完成岩盤調查與推力座的穩定分析，並把推力座背後的排水列為長期維護項目；監測計畫須包含拱腳的三維位移量測與異常門檻。

quiz.question: 要驗證「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch"?
options: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑。

optionsEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanation: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「排架立柱」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。

steps.instruction: 橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。桁架支承在排架上，拱上的排架立柱高度由約 25 英尺到 304 英尺不等，間距 72 英尺，立柱為中空斷面並以斜撐連接。登錄文件記載支承配置：靠近拱頂的幾座排架用搖軸支承，其餘排架用固定支承，拱兩端的排架則使用齒輪式伸縮支承。這種配置讓橋面與拱之間的相對溫度變形有處可釋放，又讓水平力有明確的傳遞路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「排架立柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north. The trusses sit on bents; spandrel bent columns over the arch range from about 25 ft to 304 ft tall at 72 ft spacing, with hollow sections linked by diagonal bracing. The nomination records the bearing layout: rocker shoes on the bents nearest the crown, fixed shoes elsewhere and gear-type expansion bearings on the bents at the arch ends. This arrangement releases relative thermal movement between deck and arch while giving horizontal forces a clear path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spandrel bents” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排架立柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spandrel bents” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。取 E = 200 GPa、I = 0.05 m⁴、K = 1.0：P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN；若斜撐使有效長度減半，P_cr 提高 4 倍到約 46,000 kN。I 與 K 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)². With E = 200 GPa, I = 0.05 m⁴ and K = 1.0, P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN; bracing that halves the effective length raises P_cr fourfold to about 46,000 kN. I and K are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體模型檢查高立柱在軸力、風力與溫度變形下的二階效應，並確認斜撐節點的勁度足以提供假設的側向支撐；現場檢查搖軸支承的傾角與齒輪式支承的齒合位置，與溫度對照判斷是否正常。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check second-order effects in the tall columns under axial load, wind and thermal deformation with a global model, confirming bracing joints are stiff enough to provide the assumed lateral restraint; in the field inspect rocker tilt and gear-bearing tooth engagement against temperature to judge whether they behave normally.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排架立柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spandrel bents” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體模型檢查高立柱在軸力、風力與溫度變形下的二階效應，並確認斜撐節點的勁度足以提供假設的側向支撐；現場檢查搖軸支承的傾角與齒輪式支承的齒合位置，與溫度對照判斷是否正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check second-order effects in the tall columns under axial load, wind and thermal deformation with a global model, confirming bracing joints are stiff enough to provide the assumed lateral restraint; in the field inspect rocker tilt and gear-bearing tooth engagement against temperature to judge whether they behave normally. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢查手冊應把高立柱的斜撐節點與各類支承列為重點項目，記錄每次檢查時的溫度與支承位置；任何斜撐構件的更換須先提供臨時支撐並經結構工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection manual should prioritise bracing joints of tall columns and every bearing type, recording temperature and bearing positions at each inspection; replacing any bracing member requires temporary support and structural-engineer approval first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斜撐連接若因腐蝕或鬆動失效，立柱有效長度增加，挫屈強度大幅下降；搖軸支承卡死或傾角超出設計範圍時，溫度力被迫由立柱承受，可能造成立柱彎曲或支承損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If bracing connections fail by corrosion or loosening, column effective length grows and buckling strength drops sharply; seized rockers or tilts beyond the design range force thermal loads into the columns, bending them or damaging bearings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 拱肋的上下弦桿是單室焊接箱形斷面：兩片 58 英寸高、2 至 4 英寸厚的腹板，配上兩片 39 英寸寬、約 13/16 至 1½ 英寸厚的蓋板。箱形斷面在兩個方向都有良好的抗挫屈能力，適合承受拱的巨大軸壓；上下弦之間以 Howe 式桁架腹桿連接，兩片拱肋之間以 K 形斜撐連成整體以抵抗橫向風力。焊接箱形構件的關鍵在於厚板焊接品質、殘餘應力與節點處的應力集中，這些都會影響挫屈強度與疲勞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊接箱形弦桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arch chords are single-cell welded boxes: two webs 58 in deep and 2 to 4 in thick with two cover plates 39 in wide and about 13/16 to 1½ in thick. options: 厚板全滲透焊道以超音波檢測，角焊縫以磁粒檢測抽驗。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。
optionsEn: Test thick-plate full-penetration welds ultrasonically and sample fillet welds by magnetic particle.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.
quiz.explanation: 厚板全滲透焊道以超音波檢測，角焊縫以磁粒檢測抽驗；製造後量測箱形構件的直線度、扭曲與斷面尺寸，與挫屈設計假設的初始缺陷比較；節點組裝後檢查螺栓或焊接的配合與間隙。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test thick-plate full-penetration welds ultrasonically and sample fillet welds by magnetic particle; after fabrication measure straightness, twist and section dimensions of box members against the initial imperfections assumed in buckling design; after joint assembly check fit-up and gaps of bolts or welds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Welded box chords and truss joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊接箱形弦桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Welded box chords” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚板焊接若預熱不足，可能產生層狀撕裂或氫致裂紋；箱形構件內部若積水且無排水孔，耐候鋼在長期潮濕下無法形成保護鏽層，內部腐蝕持續而不易察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient preheat on thick plates can cause lamellar tearing or hydrogen cracking; water trapped inside a box member without drain holes keeps weathering steel permanently wet so no protective patina forms, and hidden internal corrosion continues. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊接箱形構件的關鍵在於厚板焊接品質、殘餘應力與節點處的應力集中，這些都會影響挫屈強度與疲勞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For welded box members the critical issues are thick-plate weld quality, residual stresses and stress concentrations at joints, all of which affect buckling strength and fatigue.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箱形斷面是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕，也不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A box section is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Welded box chords and truss joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨越峽谷的纜索吊運」與「背拉懸臂架設與 1976 年合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The cableway across the gorge" and "Tieback cantilevering and the 1976 closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨越峽谷的纜索吊運：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The cableway across the gorge: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「纜索吊運系統」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gorge cableway” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 峽谷深而陡，無法從谷底以吊車把鋼構件吊上去，承包商於是在兩岸各設兩座約 330 英尺高的塔架，架設四條直徑 3 英寸的主纜，跨距約 3,500 英尺，以台車沿主纜把鋼構件運送到安裝位置。登錄文件記載每台台車能力 50 噸、兩台合計 100 噸，最重的一次吊運約 92 噸。纜索吊運的承載能力取決於主纜的垂度與張力：垂度越小，同樣荷載下主纜張力越大；台車移到跨中時主纜張力最大，塔架與錨碇也承受最大的水平力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「纜索吊運系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The gorge was too deep and steep to lift steel from the valley floor, so the contractor built two towers about 330 ft tall on each rim and strung four 3 in main cables across about 3,500 ft, running trolleys along them to carry steel to its erection position. The nomination records 50-ton trolleys, 100 tons combined, with a heaviest lift of about 92 tons. A cableway's capacity depends on cable sag and tension: the smaller the sag, the higher the tension for a given load; tension peaks when the trolley reaches mid-span, which also puts the largest horizontal force on towers and anchorages. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gorge cableway” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Span L = 3,500 ft ≈ 1,067 m with sag f = 5%·L ≈ 53.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時纜索吊運系統只是施工機具，不需要像永久結構一樣設計與驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A temporary cableway is just construction equipment and needs no design or verification like a permanent structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「纜索吊運系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gorge cableway”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 跨越峽谷的纜索吊運：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The cableway across the gorge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「纜索吊運系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gorge cableway” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：跨距 L = 3,500 ft ≈ 1,067 m、垂度 f = 5%·L ≈ 53.3 m。跨中集中荷載 P = 92 t ≈ 902 kN 的水平張力 H_P = P·L/(4f) ≈ 902×1,067/(4×53.3) ≈ 4,510 kN；主纜自重 0.17 kN/m 的 H_w = w·L²/(8f) ≈ 450 kN。四條主纜分擔，每條約 1,240 kN；若每條破斷力 4,500 kN，安全係數約 3.6。垂度、自重與破斷力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Span L = 3,500 ft ≈ 1,067 m with sag f = 5%·L ≈ 53.3 m. A mid-span load P = 92 t ≈ 902 kN gives H_P = P·L/(4f) ≈ 902×1,067/(4×53.3) ≈ 4,510 kN, and cable self-weight of 0.17 kN/m adds H_w = w·L²/(8f) ≈ 450 kN. Shared by four cables, each carries about 1,240 kN; with a breaking strength of 4,500 kN per cable the factor of safety is about 3.6. Sag, self-weight and breaking strength are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：纜索系統啟用前以分級荷重試驗驗證主纜、台車、塔架與錨碇，量測各級荷重下的垂度與錨碇位移；每日作業前檢查鋼索斷絲、潤滑與端部固定，風速超過門檻即停止運送。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before use, proof-load the cables, trolleys, towers and anchorages in stages while measuring sag and anchorage movement at each step; before each day's work inspect ropes for broken wires, lubrication and terminations, and stop transport when wind exceeds the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

options: 只要定期做目視檢查，就足以確定大型鋼拱橋的承載能力。
行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。

Periodic visual inspection alone is enough to establish the capacity of a large steel arch.
Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect.

steps.title: 跨越峽谷的纜索吊運：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The cableway across the gorge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「纜索吊運系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gorge cableway” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 纜索系統啟用前以分級荷重試驗驗證主纜、台車、塔架與錨碇，量測各級荷重下的垂度與錨碇位移；每日作業前檢查鋼索斷絲、潤滑與端部固定，風速超過門檻即停止運送。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before use, proof-load the cables, trolleys, towers and anchorages in stages while measuring sag and anchorage movement at each step; before each day's work inspect ropes for broken wires, lubrication and terminations, and stop transport when wind exceeds the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：臨時吊運系統應由合格工程師設計並經獨立審查，作業程序明訂荷重上限、風速門檻、每日檢查表與停止條件；任何改變台車荷重或塔架配置的變更須重新核准，系統啟用前的荷重試驗為停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Temporary hoisting systems must be designed by qualified engineers and independently checked, with procedures stating load limits, wind limits, daily checklists and stop criteria; any change to trolley loads or tower layout needs re-approval, and the pre-service load test is a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：公開資料記載施工期間曾發生纜索塔架倒塌，造成一名工人死亡、多人受傷，說明臨時吊運系統本身就是高風險結構；主纜張力或塔架穩定若只以靜力設計而忽略台車移動與擺盪的動態效應，可能在運送中失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Public records note that cableway towers collapsed during construction, killing one worker and injuring others, showing that temporary hoisting systems are high-risk structures in their own right; designing cable tension or tower stability statically while ignoring trolley motion and sway dynamics can lead to failure during transport. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 公開資料記載施工期間曾發生纜索塔架倒塌，造成一名工人死亡、多人受傷，說明臨時吊運系統本身就是高風險結構；主纜張力或塔架穩定若只以靜力設計而忽略台車移動與擺盪的動態效應，可能在運送中失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Public records note that cableway towers collapsed during construction, killing one worker and injuring others, showing that temporary hoisting systems are high-risk structures in their own right; designing cable tension or tower stability statically while ignoring trolley motion and sway dynamics can lead to failure during transport. steps.title: 背拉懸臂架設與 1976 年合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tieback cantilevering and the 1976 closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背拉索與合龍千斤頂」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tiebacks and closure jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩側半拱以懸臂方式從推力座向峽谷中央伸出，以背拉索取代谷底支架：登錄文件記載背拉索是以鋼管套管包覆的鋼絞線組，使用 9⅝ 英寸油井套管與 2⅜ 英寸鋼絞線，錨碇在推力座後方約 200 英尺的地錨基礎中。第一段弦桿於 1975 年夏季安裝，最後一件拱構件於 1976 年 5 月就位，接著以背拉系統與 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂把兩側拱臂下放、在拱頂接合；1976 年 11 月 1 日最後一段橋面桁架完成。背拉索的長度與拉力決定半拱端點的高程，合龍前必須精確調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背拉索與合龍千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each half-arch was cantilevered from its thrust block toward mid-gorge, with tiebacks replacing valley falsework: the nomination records tieback assemblies of strands in steel pipe casing, using 9⅝ in oil-well casing and 2⅜ in strands, anchored in deadman foundations about 200 ft behind the abutments. The first chord was placed in summer 1975, the last arch piece was set in May 1976, and the tieback system with sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks then lowered both arms to meet at the crown; the final deck truss was set on 1 November 1976. Tieback length and force govern the level of each half-arch tip and had to be adjusted precisely before closure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tiebacks and closure jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sixteen jacks of 1,250 tons (US short tons) total 20,000 short tons ≈ 20,000×0.907 ≈ 18,100 t, about 178 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：16 具千斤頂各 1,250 噸（美制短噸），合計 20,000 短噸 ≈ 20,000×0.907 ≈ 18,100 公噸，約 178 MN。若每側 8 具、約 89 MN，要控制的背拉力約 72 MN 時利用率約 81%。背拉力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sixteen jacks of 1,250 tons (US short tons) total 20,000 short tons ≈ 20,000×0.907 ≈ 18,100 t, about 178 MN. With 8 jacks per side, about 89 MN, controlling a tieback force of about 72 MN uses about 81% of capacity. The tieback force is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每階段安裝後量測半拱端點的三維位置與背拉索力，與施工階段分析比較；下放合龍時同步記錄每具千斤頂的油壓與行程、拱臂端點的間隙與高差，並在溫度穩定時段完成最終對位。

steps.title: 背拉懸臂架設與 1976 年合龍：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背拉索與合龍千斤頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tiebacks and closure jacks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若千斤頂不同步，同一側的背拉索受力不均，拱臂扭轉或偏位，合龍處無法對準；地錨基礎若在拉力下位移，半拱端點下沉超出預期，甚至可能使懸臂失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronised jacks load tiebacks on one side unequally, twisting or offsetting the arm so the closure cannot align; a deadman that moves under load lets the tip drop more than expected and can destabilise the cantilever. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：背拉索的長度與拉力決定半拱端點的高程，合龍前必須精確調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tieback length and force govern the level of each half-arch tip and had to be adjusted precisely before closure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「線形量測與溫度修正」與「檢查通道與載重評等」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometry surveys and temperature correction" and "Inspection access and load rating": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 線形量測與溫度修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry surveys and temperature correction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱頂高程溫度修正」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crown level temperature correction” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱的線形隨溫度變化：均勻升溫使拱軸伸長，跨度被支點固定時拱頂只能上升；日照使朝陽面與背陽面溫度不同，又造成側向彎曲。施工中每一次量測都必須記錄鋼溫，換算到參考溫度後才能與設計線形比較，否則溫度造成的位移會被誤判為安裝誤差，導致錯誤的調整。完工後，拱頂高程與溫度的關係也成為監測基準：若相同溫度下高程逐年改變，可能代表支點位移或構件損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱頂高程溫度修正」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A steel arch's geometry changes with temperature: uniform warming lengthens the arch axis, and with the span fixed by the supports the crown can only rise; sunshine heats one face more than the other and bends the arch sideways. Every survey during erection must record steel temperature and be corrected to a reference temperature before comparison with the design profile, or thermal movement will be mistaken for erection error and lead to wrong adjustments. After completion, the relation between crown level and temperature becomes a monitoring baseline: a level that changes year by year at the same temperature may indicate support movement or member damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crown level temperature correction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱頂高程溫度修正」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crown level temperature correction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線形量測與溫度修正
knowledge.text: 鋼拱的線形隨溫度變化：均勻升溫使拱軸伸長，跨度被支點固定時拱頂只能上升；日照使朝陽面與背陽面溫度不同，又造成側向彎曲。施工中每一次量測都必須記錄鋼溫，換算到參考溫度後才能與設計線形比較，否則溫度造成的位移會被誤判為安裝誤差，導致錯誤的調整。
knowledge.textEn: A steel arch's geometry changes with temperature: uniform warming lengthens the arch axis, and with the span fixed by the supports the crown can only rise; sunshine heats one face more than the other and bends the arch sideways. Every survey during erection must record steel temperature and be corrected to a reference temperature before comparison with the design profile, or thermal movement will be mistaken for erection error and lead to wrong adjustments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線形量測與溫度修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometry surveys and temperature correction" is correct?
options: 鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。
鋼拱的線形隨溫度變化：均勻升溫使拱軸伸長，跨度被支點固定時拱頂只能上升；日照使朝陽面與背陽面溫度不同，又造成側向彎曲。
只要定期做目視檢查，就足以確定大型鋼拱橋的承載能力。
optionsEn: Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored.
A steel arch's geometry changes with temperature: uniform warming lengthens the arch axis, and with the span fixed by the supports the crown can only rise.
Periodic visual inspection alone is enough to establish the capacity of a large steel arch.
quiz.explanation: 鋼拱的線形隨溫度變化：均勻升溫使拱軸伸長，跨度被支點固定時拱頂只能上升；日照使朝陽面與背陽面溫度不同，又造成側向彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A steel arch's geometry changes with temperature: uniform warming lengthens the arch axis, and with the span fixed by the supports the crown can only rise; sunshine heats one face more than the other and bends the arch sideways. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線形量測與溫度修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry surveys and temperature correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱頂高程溫度修正」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crown level temperature correction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線拱弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m。升溫 20 °C 時 Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×583.6×20 ≈ 0.140 m；跨度固定時拱矢增加 Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×518.2×0.140/(16×112.8) ≈ 0.121 m。也就是每度約 6 mm。溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m. A 20 °C rise gives Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×583.6×20 ≈ 0.140 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×518.2×0.140/(16×112.8) ≈ 0.121 m, about 6 mm per degree. The temperature change is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測選在日出前溫度均勻時進行，並在弦桿上以接觸式溫度計或埋設感測器量測鋼溫；同一點在不同溫度下多次量測，回歸出高程—溫度斜率並與理論比較；量測成果換算到參考溫度後再與設計線形比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey before sunrise when temperatures are uniform, measuring steel temperature on the chords with contact thermometers or embedded sensors; measure the same points at several temperatures, regress the level–temperature slope against theory, and compare with the design profile only after correcting to the reference temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m. A 20 °C rise gives Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×583.6×20 ≈ 0.140 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×518.2×0.140/(16×112.8) ≈ 0.121 m, about 6 mm per degree. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「線形量測與溫度修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry surveys and temperature correction", which statement holds?

Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
The parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m.

steps.title: 線形量測與溫度修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometry surveys and temperature correction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱頂高程溫度修正」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crown level temperature correction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測選在日出前溫度均勻時進行，並在弦桿上以接觸式溫度計或埋設感測器量測鋼溫；同一點在不同溫度下多次量測，回歸出高程—溫度斜率並與理論比較；量測成果換算到參考溫度後再與設計線形比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey before sunrise when temperatures are uniform, measuring steel temperature on the chords with contact thermometers or embedded sensors; measure the same points at several temperatures, regress the level–temperature slope against theory, and compare with the design profile only after correcting to the reference temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inspection catwalk” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋面下方沿全長設有約兩英尺寬的鋼製步道，原本就是為了檢查而建。對一座橋面高出河面 267 公尺的鋼拱橋而言，檢查通道決定了哪些構件能被近距離檢視：步道可以到達橋面桁架與部分排架，拱肋、高立柱與推力座則可能需要繩索技術或無人機。美國的公路橋梁須依國家橋梁檢查標準定期檢查，檢查結果與材料、斷面損失資料用於載重評等，決定橋梁能否承載法定車輛，或需要限重與補強。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「檢查步道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A steel catwalk about two feet wide runs the full length under the deck, built originally for inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inspection catwalk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 檢查通道與載重評等：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection access and load rating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢查步道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inspection catwalk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：載重評等因數 RF = (C − γ_DC·DC)/(γ_LL·(LL+IM))。某拱肋構件 C = 60 MN、恆載效應 DC = 38 MN、活載含衝擊 LL+IM = 6 MN，γ_DC = 1.25、γ_LL = 1.75：RF = (60 − 47.5)/10.5 ≈ 1.19 > 1.0；若腐蝕使容量降 5% 到 57 MN，RF ≈ 0.90，需要進一步評估。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Load rating factor RF = (C − γ_DC·DC)/(γ_LL·(LL+IM)). For an arch member with C = 60 MN, dead-load effect DC = 38 MN and live load with impact LL+IM = 6 MN, using γ_DC = 1.25 and γ_LL = 1.75, RF = (60 − 47.5)/10.5 ≈ 1.19 > 1.0; if corrosion cuts capacity 5% to 57 MN, RF ≈ 0.90 and further evaluation is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查以目視、敲擊與超音波測厚記錄斷面損失、裂紋與鬆動螺栓，斷裂關鍵構件依規定做近距離檢查；載重評等以實測斷面與材料資料更新模型，結果與前次評等比較，評等低於門檻時啟動限重或補強決策。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspections record section loss, cracks and loose bolts by visual, tapping and ultrasonic thickness methods, with hands-on examination of fracture-critical members as required; the load rating updates the model with measured sections and material data, compares with the previous rating, and triggers posting or strengthening decisions when it falls below thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term care of weathering steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint leakage on weathering steel” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。橋面伸縮縫漏水、排水管斷裂或除冰鹽水長期滴落在同一位置，會讓鋼材持續潮濕並含氯離子，鏽層變得鬆散剝落，腐蝕速率大幅增加；鳥糞與碎屑堆積在節點板與下弦桿上也有類似效果。因此耐候鋼橋的維護重點不是油漆，而是讓水離開鋼材：修好伸縮縫與排水、清除堆積物，並在局部劣化處考慮塗裝。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry. Leaking deck joints, broken drains or de-icing brine dripping on one spot keep the steel wet and chloride-laden, so the rust layer turns loose and flaky and corrosion speeds up greatly; bird droppings and debris collecting on gusset plates and bottom chords have a similar effect. Maintenance of a weathering-steel bridge is therefore not about paint but about getting water off the steel: repairing joints and drainage, removing deposits and considering local coating where deterioration has started. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint leakage on weathering steel” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint leakage on weathering steel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。取第一年損失 A = 10 μm：正常乾濕條件 n = 0.5，50 年損失 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm；長期潮濕含鹽 n = 0.8，50 年損失 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm，約為 3.2 倍。A 與 n 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ. A and n are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park; on Bridge Day, the third Saturday of October since 1980, traffic lanes close and pedestrians and parachutists take over the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bridge Day crowd load” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋梁日人群荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bridge Day crowd load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型活動應有書面結構評估、人數上限、分區與緊急疏散計畫，並由橋梁管理機關核准；交接文件包含檢查紀錄、載重評等、史蹟登錄的保存要求、活動評估與歷年維修資料，由州交通部門與國家公園管理單位共享。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Large events need a written structural assessment, crowd caps, zoning and an emergency evacuation plan approved by the bridge owner; handover files include inspections, load ratings, historic-listing conservation requirements, event assessments and repair history, shared between the state transportation department and the park service.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋梁日人群荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bridge Day crowd load” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對結構而言，大量人群集中在橋面是一種特殊荷載情境：人群密度可能高於一般設計的行人荷載假設，而且分布不均，必須事先評估並以活動管理控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Structurally, a large crowd on the deck is a special load case: crowd density can exceed ordinary pedestrian design assumptions and be unevenly distributed, so it must be assessed in advance and controlled by event management.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。
峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average.
A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.
